reason: The This Month date-range chip is a button with role=menuitem and aria-haspopup=menu inside a role=menubar, but it opens a date-range picker (a preset combobox, From and To fields and a month grid), not a menu. The menubar also has no menu keyboard model: both items are separate tab stops and ArrowLeft and ArrowRight leave focus on This Month. Screen-reader users hear "menu item, has popup menu" and are led to expect arrow-key navigation and a menu of items, which fails 4.1.2; Tab and Enter still work, so the task is possible but misleading.
